answer:
Soybean suits this field very well, scoring 92 out of 100 in suitability and proving reliable in 14 of 20 analysed years [S1]. 

The main limiting factor is temperature, with the worst month of the four-month window averaging 19.2 °C against an ideal optimum of 20 to 33 °C [S2][S1]. 

Other key factors are highly favourable and manageable: soil pH is 6.2 (within the 5.5 to 6.5 ideal range), soil texture is medium, drainage is well, and total water over the growing window is 604 mm (comprising 414 mm of rain and 190 mm of stored soil water) [S2][S1]. 

Ask your local extension office about locally adapted soybean varieties and planting dates for Story County.
